verdict.rationale: Gecko documents autonomous background workflows: scheduled scans via the API ('manage scan schedules'), automatic PR-triggered scans with pass/fail checks, auto-fix PR generation and re-verification, ticket creation, and webhook events pushed to external systems as scans run — all without manual intervention once configured. This directly matches the 'automations that run autonomously in the background' story for a security-scanning product. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that scheduled scans and auto-fix loops run reliably unattended over time, and more detail on configuring recurring schedules beyond a brief API mention.
